programmes.d: A gunfighter (Randolph Scott) loses his beloved in a robbery and hunts the man (George Macready) to blame, who is living off the loot.
On a cattle drive to Kansas after the Civil War, an ex-Union soldier comes up against Apache and Confederate renegades.
Two old-time Wyoming fur trappers (Charlton Heston, Brian Keith) try to protect a runaway Indian (Victoria Racimo) from her angry ex-mate.
An Indian sympathizer accused of running guns to the Arapaho is court-martialed by the man who framed him.

Returning from the war, Buck gets caught by Murdock, who takes his letter of introduction to the Del Reys. Posing as Buck, Murdock takes Del Ray's jewels and his daughter Jaunita. To rescue Juanita, Buck poses as Murdock.
The girlfriend (Evelyn Keyes) of a frontier doctor (Willard Parker) falls for a member (Larry Parks) of an outlaw clan.
The story of Gen. Custer (Philip Carey) and the Little Bighorn is seen through the eyes of two of his subordinates (Joseph Cotten, Darren McGavin).
Bat Masterson (George Montgomery), Doc Holliday (James Griffith) and Wyatt Earp rescue a framed rancher and stop an Indian war.
A cavalry officer and two of his men set out to make sure that a shipment of guns safely reaches its destination.
A wounded cowboy (Tim McCoy) catches rustlers who use a trick branding iron.
A banished gunfighter (Audie Murphy) returns to his sweetheart (Merry Anders) and helps his sheriff friend (James Best) face outlaws.
Framed Texan (Robert Knapp) escapes for showdown with saloonkeeper (Walter Coy).
Apaches, townsfolk, a Mexican bandit (Omar Sharif) and the cavalry follow a sheriff (Gregory Peck) to a mythical canyon of gold.
The Durango Kid attempts to thwart an outlaw's plot to turn peaceful Indians against neighboring settlers.
A Confederate plot to turn the Sioux against the Union crumbles when a double agent makes off with a shipment of gold.
One bank robber (David Brian) double-crosses another (Neville Brand), giving the undertaker and others a chance at the loot.
Two Confederates (Joe Namath, Jack Elam) save a man's (Woody Strode) life and cause trouble in 1865 Missouri.
